t.why: It sells Caspian oil and gas to Europe via Turkey. It retook Nagorno-Karabakh in 2023.
t.rel: It retook Nagorno-Karabakh in 2023 and agreed on a draft peace deal with Armenia in 2025. It is so close to Turkey that the two call themselves 'one nation, two states', and it sells Caspian oil and gas to Europe.
t.know: Gas seeping naturally from the ground feeds fires that never go out, hence 'land of fire'.
t.etext: Caspian oil and natural gas make up most exports. It is the starting point of the Southern Gas Corridor that carries gas to Europe. Its thin industrial base outside energy is the challenge.
